description: Every command the website try-it tools, Catch Host, the catch CLI and later WhatsApp call. One entry per command: one callable, its payload and response schemas (which share contracts/shared/command_envelope.schema.json), what it may change, who may call it and which surfaces expose it. functions/src/commands/catalog.test.ts keeps this file, the schemas and the Functions exports in step.

effectClasses.draft: Writes only the caller's own private, unpublished records.
effectClasses.publishes: Makes something visible to the public or to guests.
effectClasses.messages-guests: Sends a message to guests. Needs confirm with the reviewed preview's hash.
effectClasses.moves-money: Charges, refunds or pays out. Needs confirm with the reviewed preview's hash.

commands.summary: Give a phone-verified caller their one try-it workspace: a private organizer they own, which every try-it tool writes into.
Read one public page (Instagram, Luma, Linktree or a website) and fill the caller's try-it workspace from it, or route them to claim the organizer Catch already lists.
